title: Troubleshooting: transfer delays
summary: This troubleshooting guide explains why an instant transfer may be delayed from posting. It covers common causes (temporary maintenance, security review, connectivity interruption, incorrect destination details) and steps to refresh the activity feed, verify account details, wait and retry, and contact support with the date, amount, and reference ID if pending.
